subject: Request: Extended fallback lease & pin for critical checkout flows
messages:
From: Kristen Hall <kristen@bridgepay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fallback lease request for canary — urgent

Sergio,

Thanks for taking this quickly. We're ramping a new checkout flow that routes ~18% of payments through an A/B variant. Last week we saw a 120ms median latency increase on the new variant under peak and our fraud scoring window is sensitive to that. Our ops team is asking for a temporary safety measure: the ability to pin traffic back to the stable version and keep that pin in place (a "fallback lease") beyond the usual auto-revert window for up to 72 hours if we hit the latency threshold.

What we need from Redwood:
- Explicit approval to apply a fallback lease that prevents auto-swap for up to 72 hours
- A clearly defined latency trigger (we propose p95 > 450ms for 10m) and the telemetry Redwood will use to evaluate it
- A signed amendment for the short exception so our compliance/legal can close the loop

I've attached a quick SLA matrix and a draft amendment for your legal team. Can you confirm whether this is possible and what approvals you need on your side? This is time-sensitive — our Black Friday-esque prep starts next week.

Thanks,
Kristen Hall
Head of Platform Reliability
BridgePay
attachments: bridgepay_sla_matrix_q3.xlsx, proposed-amendment-draft.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kristen Hall <kristen@bridgepay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fallback lease request for canary — urgent

Kristen — appreciate the details. Short answer: yes, we can support an extended fallback lease in exceptional cases, but we need a few conditions met to protect both sides and the platform. Looping in Lauren (CS) and Marissa (SRE) to set the guardrails.

To move forward I need the following from you by end of day tomorrow:
- Confirmation of the latency threshold you want enforced (your suggested p95 > 450ms / 10m is reasonable; please confirm)
- The exact UTC window(s) you expect to run the canary during the 72-hour period
- Point of contact for BridgePay ops (pager/email) for rapid post-fallback troubleshooting

Operational notes:
- Our fallback action will be a single-version pin (no split traffic) and an automatic swap back to the canary only after a manual clear or after the agreed lease expires
- We'll enable additional telemetry retention for the canary routes for the exception window (48–72 hours, per approval)

Lauren/Marissa — can you confirm the internal approval route and whether we require an amendment/fee for the extended lease? Also flag any rollback criteria you want enforced.

I'll draft a short amendment once we have the confirmed thresholds and window; we can route it via DocuSign for signature.

— Sergio
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kristen Hall <kristen@bridgepay.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fallback lease request for canary — internal approval and conditions

Team — I reviewed the ask and BridgePay's risk profile. Approve in principle with the following binding conditions:

1) Duration cap: fallback lease authorized up to 72 hours maximum. Any extension requires VP-level sign-off (legal/CS).
2) Telemetry & rollback criteria: we will consider the fallback trigger reached if p95 latency >= 450ms for a continuous 10-minute window AND error rate on the canary path increases > 0.5 percentage points over baseline. Both conditions must be true to execute the fallback.
3) Post-fallback watch: BridgePay must provide a dedicated on-call contact; Redwood SRE will stand by for the first 4 hours post-fallback and produce a 24-hour incident snapshot for postmortem.
4) Amendment: we'll require a short-term amendment (limited-scope addendum) that documents the temporary exception and the rollback criteria. No change to base SLA, this is a one-off operational carveout.
5) Billing/credits: no automatic crediting; if rollback results in measurable loss attributable to Redwood service we will evaluate credits case-by-case.

Marissa — tech caveats: we will implement an "escape hatch" that enforces immediate pin and disables auto-revert for the lease period. We should also enable an opt-in for BridgePay to let us push a hotfix to the pinned variant if needed. Confirm feasibility and whether we need an Ops runbook change.

If all parties sign off, Sergio please prepare the amendment for signature and include the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success (Americas)
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kristen Hall <kristen@bridgepay.com>, BridgePay Legal <legal@bridgepay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Extended fallback lease & pin for critical checkout flows

Kristen — thanks for confirming the threshold (p95 >= 450ms over 10m) and the expected canary windows. Per Lauren's conditions, Redwood will provision a temporary fallback lease with the following finalized terms:

- Lease duration: up to 72 hours (auto-expire at end of window). Any extension triggers VP-level review.
- Trigger: p95 >= 450ms for a continuous 10-minute period AND canary error rate > baseline by 0.5pp.
- Action: immediate pin to stable version (100% traffic), disable auto-swap for the lease window.
- Post-action: Redwood SRE on-call for first 4 hours; 24-hour incident snapshot and joint postmortem within 5 business days.
- Amendment: short addendum to the Master Services Agreement describing the exception; signature via DocuSign required before we enact the lease.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/links/BP-Fallback-LEASE-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3421-BP-2026-0942

Requested next steps for BridgePay:
1) Legal to review and sign the addendum at the DocuSign link above.
2) Confirm ops POC (name and pager/email).
3) Confirm the exact UTC windows for the canary run.

Once we have the signed addendum and ops POC, Marissa will schedule the configuration change and the Telemetry retention increase. If you want us to prepare the opt-in hotfix channel for the pinned variant, say so and we'll include that in the addendum.

cc: Lauren/Marissa — please treat this as high priority once DocuSign completes.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
